title: Lotus Guardian
description: A green-skinned woman with a white headscarf emerges from a pond filled with pink lotus flowers and lily pads. She is surrounded by multiple identical floating figures of a woman in a red patterned dress arranged symmetrically on both sides, with a large dragonfly resting on her chest.
prompt: A green-skinned mystical woman with a white headscarf rises from a turquoise pond covered in pink lotus flowers and lily pads. A large detailed dragonfly rests on her chest. Multiple identical floating figures of a woman in flowing red patterned dresses are arranged symmetrically on both sides against a geometric chevron background in pastel tones. Ethereal bubbles float throughout the scene, soft glowing atmosphere, surreal fantasy style.
